notes: Diff of 19518 lines reviewed by structure, partly because functions moved in the text. For each of the 20 changed functions I compared the counts of calls, loops, aborts, logs, reverts, requires, storage writes and returns between the old and new text and read every hunk where a count changed: the remove*SourceConfig family, setTokenType, sequencerL2Data, getPriceView, getPriceDetailedView, setPriceMode, setSourceConfig (+3 twins with identical counts), _getPriceImplNoWrite (the write-path removal checked against main.sol:1092 _readSourceMaybeWrite and :1668 '_getPriceImpl(.., false)'), the zero-init loop of getConfiguredTokenOracles, and multicall. getPrice, getPriceDetailed, getPriceRawForMode, getPricesRawForMode and getConfiguredTokenOracles keep all their counts; their changes are memory rebases (mem[_262 + 96] -> mem[_261 + 224]), return_data reads, and ctx fields read as _param3/_param4. setPriceMode drops a dead 'mem[64] = mem[64] + 96' and rebases the later reads consistently on both branches (mem[mem[64] + 108 len 20] != caller). Assignments that came before 'break' in the sequencer do-while loops now come after the loop: exact, because break is the loop's only exit. multicall keeps a one-statement rotation ('mem[160] = 96' before 'while idx - 1:'), within the two-statement limit; the regex counts it as no P3.
summary: No regression. Many raw-memory artifacts are gone (P2 293->203, P4 88->6, plain logs/returns/range checks), as are P12 tails, the dead write path of _getPriceImplNoWrite and a P3 rotation. The 13 aborts and the 59 exp-helper loops remain.
